name: Clear Cutter's Axe
text:
Wielded by wealthy Taldan knights against the Goroth Lodge, this +1 striking returning hatchet has an axe head resembling a roaring lion's head.

---

Activate—Slash and Burn r (manipulate)

Trigger You critically succeed at a Strike against a plant

Effect The weapon's etchings pulse with green energy, as it tears through bark, leaf, and wood. The clear cutter's axe deals an additional 1d10 persistent,fire damage to the plant.

---

Activate—Mow Down 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You hurl the axe horizontally, sending it flying through the air in a wild, whirling cyclone. The axe flies in a 30-foot emanation around you, eliminating all non-magical undergrowth and any resulting difficult terrain, cover, and concealment in area. It attempts to counteract one magical effect that affects a plant in the area (counteract +20). Plant creatures in the area take 5d6 slashing damage (DC 25 basic Reflex save save). As the axe finishes its circuit, it returns to your hand.
